purpose: Keep canonical ingredient identity separate from official nutrient records and preparation states.
rules: A canonical ingredient may map to multiple official records.
Raw, boiled, grilled, roasted, dried and other states are never silently merged.
Website default must select an explicit representative record and display its basis.
If K-FIND and USDA differ, retain both source records; do not average them automatically.
